address: 4 Compton Avenue, Islington, London, N1 2XD, United Kingdom

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Having stood for over 200 years, The Compton Arms pub is an Islington institution, and in recent years has become known for offering residencies to up-and-coming young chefs. The current occupants are Jay Claus and Syrus Pickhaver, who offer the kind of simple yet effective, retro-British cooking that Londoners love right now. These are dishes designed for tucking in and putting a smile on your face, like half a roast chicken with chips and curry mayo, or ray wing tenders on a crumpet with hot golden syrup. The service team maintain a relaxed, friendly vibe.
